description: Create a new ticket in the workspace. Returns the created ticket, with notes when it matches another ticket. A new ticket goes to the bottom of the Backlog. When the person asks for the Icebox, it goes to the top of the Icebox. Place one anywhere else only when the person asks. In the description, Open with a sentence or two in plain words saying what happened or what is asked, before any detail. Write #123 only for a ticket number, and p45 for a project.

assignee_ids.description: User IDs to assign, from list_people

due_date.description: Due date as YYYY-MM-DD, on any ticket; it has to be in the future. Set one only when the person gives a date.

insert_at.description: Where in the panel: top, bottom, before:<ticket id> or after:<ticket id>

labels.description: Label names, as list_labels shows them

panel.description: Which panel the ticket goes in: backlog (the default) or icebox. A new ticket goes to the bottom of the Backlog. When the person asks for the Icebox, it goes to the top of the Icebox. Place one anywhere else only when the person asks.

points.description: Effort estimate in points (0, 1, 2, 3, 5, or 8): how much work the ticket takes. Not a time estimate, and not a rating of how complex or difficult the work is. Every ticket has points before it starts: estimate them yourself, or use the person's number when they give one.

project_id.description: Project external ID to assign to

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.

name: create_ticket
title: Create a ticket
